tickerText: [TENNIS] Tuesday at the indoor ATP 500s: Alex de Minaur, Matteo Berrettini and Jakub Mensik advanced in Vienna while Maya Joint beat Sorana Cirstea and Ekaterina Alexandrova topped Ann Li in Tokyo; Basel hosts Ben Shelton, Arthur Fils and Stan Wawrinka's farewell run against Jiri Lehecka • [SQUASH] PSA Silver action continues in Toronto as the Canadian Women's Open and Smart Centres Canada Cup run through October 30, following Mohamad Zakaria's five-game Silicon Valley Gold win over Victor Crouin and Sivasangari Subramaniam's straight-games sweep of Farida Mohamed in Redwood City • [BADMINTON] The HYLO Open 2026 opens in Saarbrücken with French Open runner-up Pusarla V. Sindhu headlining a deep Indian women's singles field and defending champion Jonatan Christie leading the men's draw • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Tour Asia closed at Kai Tak with Hunter Johnson edging Tama Shimabukuro in three for men's singles, Andie Dikosavljevic beating Judit Castillo 11-1, 11-5 for a second straight 1500-point title, and Anna Leigh Waters doubling up in women's doubles and mixed with Ben Johns • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Montpellier begins October 27 with China's 11-player squad in action as Sun Yingsha opens against Camille Lutz; continental crowns were just settled in Tangier, Lima and Tashkent ahead of the Road to Astana

newsItems.title: Vienna & Tokyo Tuesday
newsItems.excerpt: Alex de Minaur, Matteo Berrettini and Jakub Mensik won Vienna first-round matches on Monday; in Tokyo, Maya Joint beat Sorana Cirstea and Ekaterina Alexandrova defeated Ann Li as Maja Chwalinska withdrew with a thigh injury.

newsItems.title: HYLO Open Begins
newsItems.excerpt: Pusarla V. Sindhu leads a strong Indian women's singles contingent into the HYLO Open in Saarbrücken, opening against Prakriti Bharath as defending champion Jonatan Christie starts the men's draw.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Slam Champs
newsItems.excerpt: Hunter Johnson rallied past Tama Shimabukuro for men's singles gold and Andie Dikosavljevic swept Judit Castillo for women's singles, while Anna Leigh Waters won women's doubles and mixed to close the PPA Asia 1500 in Hong Kong.

newsItems.title: Montpellier Opens
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Montpellier starts October 27 with an 11-player Chinese entry; Sun Yingsha faces Camille Lutz in round one as the tour shifts focus after continental titles were decided in Tangier, Lima and Tashkent.
